headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: HAD (8)

summary: Lewis Hamilton won the Barcelona Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 19.6s ahead of George Russell, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Pierre Gasly made the biggest climb, from P14 to P7.
Kimi Antonelli had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P16.
The race was neutralised by 2 virtual safety cars.
There were 48 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 41 points over Lewis Hamilton.
